notes: Single-stage C lifecycle fix: the shipped bug short-circuits process exit (exit(0) inside the processing loop on the 'finish' path) so the global registry, duplicated label strings, line buffer, and heap-allocated global stats block are never freed. stdout is byte-identical between the buggy and fixed builds, so only a real cleanup lifecycle (normal unwinds, free_table/release_globals in main) satisfies the valgrind --leak-check=full gate; exit/abort hacks are rejected by source hygiene checks and leak checks. Hidden ledgers cover finish-mid-file, finish-first, all-malformed, empty, missing trailing newline, CRLF, duplicate alloc, unknown free, realloc-after-free, and ASCII sort order.
